# Proxied-server cmd test shard manifest.
#
# Format: <total_shards> <shard_number> <top_level_test_name>
#
# 34-shard split for the Bazel-only proxied-server tier
# (bazel-proxied in .github/workflows/bazel.yml), bin-packed
# longest-processing-time-first by measured wall-time from
# scripts/ci/proxied_test_durations.json (see that file for
# provenance and its "relative weight, not absolute SLA" caveat).
# Regenerate with scripts/ci/gen_proxied_shard_manifest.py 34
# --weights=duration --write after adding or removing
# TestProxiedServer*/TestServerMode* functions. --write is incremental:
# it keeps every already-assigned test on its current shard and only
# places newly-discovered names, onto whichever shard is currently
# lightest, so two unrelated PRs that each add one test do not textually
# conflict or silently invalidate each other's packing. Pass --repack to
# force a full from-scratch rebalance instead (a deliberate, separate
# change — expect a large diff). --check only verifies every discovered
# name is listed here exactly once (no stale or duplicate entries); it
# does NOT verify the packing is still well-balanced, so a reweighted
# proxied_test_durations.json does not by itself fail --check — rerun
# with --repack periodically (or whenever shard loads look uneven in CI)
# to rebalance on purpose. Newly-added tests not listed here
# hash-distribute via proxied-test-shard.sh: cksum(name) % total,
# unrelated to proxied_test_durations.json (that file only feeds this
# generator's own cost estimate for a test it has not measured yet).
#
# This file is generated: notes added here are erased by the next
# regeneration. Add them to the generator or the durations file
# instead.
